faq_heading: Questions about AI SEO agent cost vs hiring an SEO manager

faqs.q: Is an AI SEO agent cheaper than hiring an SEO manager?
faqs.a: Usually the monthly commitment is smaller, because you pay for one service instead of a salary, tools, writers and hiring time. But cheaper is not the point. Compare what each option publishes every month and who owns the results.

faqs.q: Can an AI SEO agent replace an SEO manager?
faqs.a: For a small team that mainly needs consistent publishing, indexing and tracking, often yes. A larger company with brand, product and technical SEO needs may still want a human lead who directs the agent.

faqs.q: What costs do people forget when hiring an SEO manager?
faqs.a: The tools, freelance writers or designers, the months of recruiting and ramp-up, and the cost of a wrong hire. A salary line alone understates the true cost.

faqs.q: How fast does each option show results?
faqs.a: Neither is instant. Google says changes can take from several hours to several months to show. An agent usually starts publishing in the first weeks, while a hire first needs recruiting and onboarding.

faqs.q: What does Clara AI's SEO agent include?
faqs.a: It researches topics, writes and publishes pages daily from facts you approve, asks Google to index them, tracks results and sends you a weekly update. Buyers reach you on WhatsApp. We aim to show you a first demo within 7 days.
